This feels natural — I added "Design" right there on the CSS Grid card, it showed up as a chip alongside the one it already had, and clicking the "Design" chip narrowed the whole library down to just what carries it. Adding labels directly on the card and having them as visible chips is exactly how I'd picture it, and I like that a card can carry more than one.

One thing I noticed while adding the label: I typed it in freehand with no help. Down the road I'll have a fair few labels, and I could easily type "Design" one time and "design" or "designs" another and end up with near-duplicates without realizing. So when I start typing a label, I'd want it to suggest the labels I already have so I can just pick the existing one instead of retyping it. Everything else about this — the chips, adding on the card, clicking to filter — is spot on. Could we add that suggesting-as-I-type part?
